facts.statement: Referees usually host their parties in Seaside, Blackspore or Sanctuary; the timing is unpredictable and players are told to watch for them.
facts.quote: The Refs usually host their parties in Seaside, Blackspore or Sanctuary.

article_summaries.title: Referees Party Too!
article_summaries.summary: A Free Realms news post (captured March 2010) says the in-game Referees, who warp around answering questions and helping players, also hold parties, usually in Seaside, Blackspore or Sanctuary. It shows four example parties with Referees Shadow, Blue, Heliotrope and Ruby and invites players to watch for them. The post gives no absolute date, only a relative 'posted 5 days, 16 hours ago'.
